reviews.title: AS3 Areas 1-6 and Area 7 flash.media full Working promotion (437 declarations)
reviews.summary: Implements standalone LZMA ByteArray compression, full AS3 language/operator/directive/Proxy/E4X surface, multi-run TextField formatting and HTML/CSS/justify/inline-image layout, BitmapData 15-BlendMode draw and DisplacementMapFilter, InteractiveObject/Stage events, and Rust-backed flash.media Sound/SoundChannel/SoundTransform/SoundMixer/ID3Info/Video.
